display_name: 固定盲信道条件先验网络逐场景源域复核
description: 固定扩展训练最终盲信道估计器，重建源域条件先验并以盲保护门在RX4/6逐场景筛选，RX8作为留出观察。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU0 single process; CPU 2 threads; TF32 disabled; fixed-checkpoint source action matrix reference smoke

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256]; inference from fixed blind action network, source prior and input gate only; DURA benchmark only
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels, U_s truth, V or test read; F clean pseudo targets for source evaluation
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source training-role heldout records for selection, 3921 RX8 exploratory heldout; physical IDs were observed in prior channel views

permissions.query_use: Source-only pilot with RX8 source holdout; no target IQ, V, or truth
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed source-only diagnostic; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Exact fixed epoch10 blind estimator checkpoint SHA-256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338; source prior fit 8192 fixed IDs and source gate; F frozen; DURA benchmark only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind estimator code 94693a342bb2daa684c0f21415d7b949f9fb2107, fixed weights SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338; conditional prior dependency dff683121e48ba8ab4ae7619ea895dad690bd77c.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: RX4/6: each receiver/scene pseudo correct drop <= max(1,ceil(.5% valid)); clean IQ <=DURA+.001; impaired IQ <=1.2*DURA+1e-6; aggregate impaired gain >=10; thresholds .8/.99; RX8 not used. Report separate accuracy-only audit without impaired IQ limit.
